provenance: Owned by RI-QST03. Wave-0 container; ranks are the structure, not the content.
w1_20_note: THIS FILE IS NOT THE ROSTER AND SAYS SO NOW. It shipped as a wave-0 skeleton with two
bodies and three ranks each while the running game had eight eight-rank ladders in
quests/faction-gates.json, and the only place in the tree that recorded the fact was a
comment in tools/lib/gamedata.mjs. dialogue/faction-reactions.json names W1-20 as the
roster's owner, so the correction belongs here.
It is DECLARED rather than rewritten, deliberately. Promoting this file into a second full
roster would put a ninth and tenth statement of the same facts in the build, and two ladders
for one body is a defect this project has already paid for twice (deep_kin / the_xul_aneekh,
and `intelligence` surviving in three ladders because the attribute list was restated). The
reader is tools/lib/gamedata.mjs loadFactions(), which returns this object under `.skeleton`
and the real ladders under `.ladders`. That is a TOOLS-side reader and not a world-side one,
and this note says so rather than claiming a consumption it does not have.
The two bodies below are correct and are both NON-JOINABLE, for the reasons in
corpus/30-quests/FACTION-ROSTER-DESIGN.md §2 (House Dres is weather, not a career) and §3
(the Shadowscales are a service you send for, not a guild you climb). Their ranks stay
because a Dres factor and a ku-vastei each HAVE a rank and the player must be able to read

joinable_bodies._note: The seven careers, and the quest that is each one's door. Measured through play by tools/quests/faction-joining-probe.mjs, not asserted here.

factions.name: House Dres
factions.why_not_joinable: FACTION-ROSTER-DESIGN.md §2. Dres has no province-side institution to climb; its factors are foreign and in Argonia on sufferance. It is the substrate three other ladders are built on and the antagonist of two.

factions.name: The Shadowscale Order
factions.why_not_joinable: FACTION-ROSTER-DESIGN.md §3 and RI-CRM02 §1 row 3. A ku-vastei is an arbiter you send for and pay, not a ladder. These ranks describe the person you are talking to.
